scope: Independent read-only resource and control-plane diagnostics; no production modification

observations.interpretation: Configured capacity, not current usage, delivered IOPS, CPU, or burst-credit balance.
No filesystem size/available/used-byte metrics were returned. 500 is the HTTP failure status, not utilization.
An empty object supplies no evidence about live Postgres settings or process state.

diagnostic_findings.finding: The readonly status endpoint also fails with a database TCP connection refused at port 5432. It does not return a read-only-mode boolean.
The metrics scrape is unavailable (HTTP 521), so this investigation has no current CPU, memory, Disk IO, or credit-balance measurements.
The addons endpoint succeeds but has no selected addons or selected compute entry. An exact active instance size cannot be derived from this response.

The management schema exposes disk capacity, filesystem utilization and a current Prometheus scrape. It has no dedicated OOM, CPU-credit, historical resource series, or compute burst-credit balance endpoint.
Available compute options contain baseline_disk_io_mbs and max_disk_io_mbs separately from volume IOPS/throughput. A configured gp3 volume does not establish remaining compute-level IO budget.
Disk full, out-of-memory kill, exhausted burst credits and the current CPU/IO level remain unconfirmed.
Prior root application DB size was approximately 31.7 MB. This excludes filesystem-level WAL, logs, temporary files and system overhead, so it cannot rule out filesystem exhaustion.

The root found no 53100/53200/25006, no-space, could-not-write, or OOM matches, but recent database logs stop before the current outage. The missing log interval prevents treating zero matches as proof of absence.

recommended_next_evidence: When the host metrics path becomes reachable, read current filesystem available bytes, memory/oom indicators and resource metrics once; use two timestamped samples only if calculating a CPU or IO rate.

Obtain provider-side instance lifecycle, kernel/OOM or volume-health/credit evidence through existing operator access if available; API schemas and the current failed metrics GET cannot replace these measurements.

Avoid additional SQL polling while the database port refuses connections. Any historical logs query should target a bounded interval around the last DB log and startup/crash/no-space/OOM messages, coordinated with root.
